situation (example wording): "What states have seen an increase in murder rates over the past 7 years?"
what the app does today: Asked or declined: a change across all states was not built.
proposed behavior: "States that have seen an increase" over N years is the states whose rate ROSE: only those states, as a table State | rate then | rate now | change, ranked by the change, highest first, from Crime Index's state figures, the latest complete year against the year N years earlier, the span in the title ("States Where the Murder Rate Rose, 2018 to 2025"). A state whose rate fell or stayed is not listed; a state with a blank year is left out and counted in a note. A decrease is the same with the states that fell. No span named is the last five complete years (P188).
exact default or choices offered: The table of the states that rose, ranked by the change, the span in the title.
status: Decided 2026-11-22 (Jeff, through the coordinator); build: Engine
